lessons_used: Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced one confirmed winning test, though other tests showed no clear effect.
Path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) delivered one winning test, while an earlier test showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once (such as sign-in reordering or layout, path copy or layout, home redesign, and finish notifications or screens).
Predictions were generally too optimistic, though impact was underestimated for certain winning tests like path redesign and story copy reframing.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Trait Builder on Friend Selection
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a split layout featuring personality trait selection cards alongside a live mascot visual.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high dropoff rate (65.9% conversion, median 89s) and support mails report custom pet generation outputs failing or looking wrong.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a mascot cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Quick-Start Desktop Pet Quick Interactions Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive quick-start screen right before final completion that lets users try moving and speaking to their desktop companion in a mini sandbox.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, while finish conversion remains low at 64.8%.

new_pet_quickstart.headline: Try Moving and Talking to Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_quickstart.body: Click and drag your companion across your desktop or send a quick greeting to see how it responds.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new quick-start interactive screen after home intro without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen at final onboarding historically yielded -4.3% lift despite support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Express Preset Companion Selection Flow
candidates.change: Add a single-click popular preset companion choice flow on the pet pick screen for fast onboarding without heavy customization.
candidates.why: Adoption mean time is 1017s with a 34.1% churn rate, indicating significant friction during detailed custom creation.

pick_friend.headline: Choose an Instant Starter Companion or Create Custom

guard.reason: Adds an express pet selection option on the pick friend screen without removing core capabilities.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 34.1% churn and 1017s mean time on adoption screen; adoption redesigns average +2.2% lift.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Companion Vibe Selection Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a full-bleed visual showcase featuring animated archetype cards.
candidates.why: Path selection redesigns previously proved effective in boosting onboarding conversion, and choose_path currently drops 19.7% of users.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Accessory Gift Reward
candidates.change: Award an exclusive launch day desk toy accessory badge on the completion intro screen to incentivize finishing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with total onboarding completion reaching only 20.3%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready + First Day Gift Unlocked!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras, violating pricing and copy rules.

candidates.title: Two Column Visual Social Sign-In Layout
candidates.change: Reorganize the sign-in screen into a clean two-column layout featuring sign-in benefits alongside quick auth buttons.
candidates.why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of starting users, and 8 support complaints cite missing or reset pets due to account linking issues.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Secure Your Custom Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Keep your pet safe and synced across desktop reboots and devices.

guard.reason: Reorganizes sign-in layout cleanly without altering core functionality or rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both funnel dropoff (27.1%) and support complaints; previous sign_in layout test showed +2.6%.

candidates.title: Completion Notification Alert Switch on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notification toggles on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is extremely long (2336s / ~38 mins), showing users navigate away or forget the app during background processing.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet... We Will Notify You When Ready!

guard.reason: Adds readiness notification switch while retaining the pet generation indication on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost notification switch targeting extreme wait time on home screen.

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Outcome Story Copy Reframing
candidates.change: Rewrite story copy to emphasize daily emotional companionship benefits rather than system path options.
candidates.why: Story copy reframing previously succeeded as a winning test, demonstrating that users respond strongly to outcome-oriented emotional copy.

story.headline: A Daily Companion Built Right Into Your Workspace
story.body: Choose whether you want a calm co-working buddy, an encouraging productivity guide, or a playful desk pet.

guard.reason: Reframes story copy while continuing to introduce the companion as required.

candidates.score_note: Copy-only change leveraging previously confirmed winning story copy reframing pattern (+3.3%).

candidates.title: Custom Engraved Collar Name Tag Badge
candidates.change: Add a custom engraved name tag component to the adoption certificate screen to heighten emotional connection.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high dropoff rate (34.1% lost); giving users early tactile customization increases ownership before entering the desktop.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[1]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Interactive Sound Lounge Waiting Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight lounge with pet audio previews and companion trivia tips.
candidates.why: Home waiting step exhibits extreme idle time (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing dropoff before onboarding completion.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen with audio previews while still indicating the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: High effort redesign on home wait step; historical home redesign test yielded -2.8%.

lessons_next: Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) did not help, resulting in one worse outcome and one with no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as sign-in reordering, adoption flows, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the impact of winning tests like path selection redesign and initial path copy reframing.
